title: AOI result file
description: One board's result, written by the AOI PoC Inspector to the output folder within 1 s of its verdict (REQ-INSP-021) as <board ID>_<record UUID>.json, with the same fields as one CSV line in <board ID>_<record UUID>.csv and in shift_<local date>.csv. CSV columns: board_id, view, verdict, time, model_version, recipe_rev, defect_count, defects (each type:severity:x,y,w,h, joined by |), evidence, board_model, record_uuid; an empty cell is null.

board_id.description: The board's ID: the image file's name without its extension, until the line's file-naming contract (REQ-INSP-020) says how to read it.

view.description: The camera view the image shows, e.g. Top or Side.

time.description: When the record was saved, UTC, ISO 8601 with an offset.

model_version.description: The AI model version active when the board was judged; null with no AI model.

recipe_rev.description: The recipe revision that judged the board; null with no recipe saved.

box.description: In pixels of the inspected image, from its top-left corner.

evidence.description: What the station kept of the board: its overlay and maps as PNG, an OK board's overlay as JPEG (D1), or none, for an OK board saved at a full disk (REQ-LOG-006).

record_uuid.description: The station's record of the board, as Logs & Export and its CSV export name it.
